summary: This bill requires individuals and groups making electioneering communications to file reports electronically and allows political committees to make disbursements using methods other than checks.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Federal Election Campaign Act to require electronic filing for certain electioneering communications and allows political committees to use disbursement methods other than checks. These are administrative changes aimed at modernizing campaign finance reporting and transactions, which are directly related to the conduct and transparency of elections.
